reason: Reviewed non-promoting characterization/design; excluded from the 461 assertion-bearing case credit; source retained.

contract.intent: Characterize rollback of the first readable argument when lifting a later already-locked readable fails
contract.preconditions: COMMON; fresh owned fixture required; first stream unlocked, second stream held by caller reader
trace: submit ordered object containing first stream then locked second stream
poll first stream lock and cancel count
release second reader and clean up public handles
contract.stress: Two streams, one held reader, at most 100 checks with 10ms spacing; no data production
contract.oracle: First origin unlocks and cancel executes once; receiver accepted zero; later RPC works; leaked lock is explicit FAIL/CLEANUP_BLOCKED
contract.cleanup: Cancel and release held reader in finally; cancel first stream only if unlocked; always owned fixture teardown, never hidden runtime table access
